projectDescription: An all-in-one management platform for animal rescues and shelters, covering animals, people, fundraising, shifts, communications, and a public website from one shared record.
keyFeatures: Single shared record for every animal and person across all workspaces
Animals workspace: intake, medical records, placement matching, adoptions and fosters
People workspace: multi-role records for adopters, fosters, volunteers, and donors
Fundraising with Stripe integration, campaigns, wish lists, and payout reconciliation
Shift scheduling with self-serve volunteer booking and coordinator-controlled rules
Shared team inboxes with threading, templates, and custom domain email sending
Public website auto-generated from rescue data with adoptable animals and forms
Public Registry: cross-rescue safety flags and microchip registration/lookup
Forms and workflows to automate intake, adoption, and volunteer processes
Custom fields, record layouts, and 13+ built-in roles with full permission control
API keys and webhooks for integration with Zapier, Make, and custom systems
Import from spreadsheet (animals, people, donations); export any list as CSV
publicApiSurface: Webhooks for record change events (compatible with Zapier and Make)
CSV import: animals, people, donations, events
CSV export: all lists including custom fields
Stripe payment integration for donations and adoption fees
Public microchip lookup endpoint (no auth required)
Embeddable adoptable-animals widget for external websites
